discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 to 245_b087/269_b123 (cell B147). Reuses existing keys. All search_snippet; 30 searches. Holds resolved: mailbox/tiana (MPC per-pin entry), pixar-movie-ticket/cars (MPC per-pin entry), grandfather-clock/the-aristocats and /peter-pan (BoxLunch listing: each clock themed to a different film). New 2026 sets from DPB dated posts + BoxLunch listings: Crown Display Pillows (Sep), Toy Story Character Lollipops (May), Villain Sidekicks Portrait (Jul), Fairies (Jul), Roller Skate (Jul, year to confirm), Flip Flop (Jul, set only), Moana (Jul), Balcony Scene (Aug), Storybook Moments (Aug), Pets Hanging Portrait (Aug), Sidekicks Gaming (Aug). Roster pins carry holds except 4 Sidekicks Gaming pins named on the BoxLunch listing with 'collect all six' wording. Cozy Cone lead resolved to 2025.
